page: Google Cloud Platform n2-standard-2 is a general-purpose virtual machine configuration based on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 2 dedicated vCPUs operating on 1 physical Intel Xeon core at a base frequency of 2.8 GHz with multithreading enabled. The instance includes 8.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The processor includes 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 33 MB of shared L3 cache, with hardware support for vector processing extensions including AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI, alongside AES cryptographic acceleration.

The instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated hardware accelerators, featuring 0 GPUs and no default local NVMe drives. Consequently, all persistent storage and external network access must be mounted via attached cloud block storage and configured networking interfaces. In addition, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

Synthetic benchmark results place this entry-level configuration in the lower performance tiers due to its low absolute core count. The instance achieved 1362.9 in stress-ng single-core and 1806.8 in multi-core testing, falling into the bottom 10% to 25% of evaluated systems. Geekbench testing returned scores of 1137.0 for single-core and 1379.0 for multi-core workloads, with PassMark measuring an overall CPU score of 2129.47 and memory score of 1400.74. Throughput tests show 13.47 GB/sec for large-block uncached memory reads, 11.35 GB/sec for large-block writes, 1.61 million Redis SET operations per second, and 2.41 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

From an efficiency standpoint, the dedicated vCPU allocation provides predictable performance execution without the throttling risks associated with burstable shared-core instances. However, compute throughput is bounded by the single dual-threaded physical core. The instance is suited for lightweight utility workloads, low-traffic web serving, microservices, small development environments, and baseline CI/CD worker nodes.
description: Google Cloud Platform n2-standard-2 is a general-purpose virtual machine configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs and 8.0 GB of RAM on the x86_64 architecture. Driven by an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.8 GHz across 1 physical core with hyperthreading, the system features a 33 MB L3 cache and supports AVX-512 vector instructions and AES cryptography. The server does not bundle local disk storage or GPU accelerators, requiring attached network storage for persistent disk needs. Performance benchmarks reflect its low core count, producing a Geekbench multi-core score of 1379.0, a PassMark CPU score of 2129.47, and Redis throughput of 1.61 million operations per second. Delivering stable dedicated CPU execution without burst throttling, this instance is suited for low-traffic web applications, background processing tasks, microservices, and development environments.
